requirement.statement: No sovereignty requirement was provided: no applications file gives a tier or constraints. It is not inferred from the location of the company or of the provider.

dimensions.name: Data location

observed_source_state.text: The location of the source resources is not read: this build computes no region or zone placement for the source.

proposed_target_state.text: Name resolution: stackit_network.vpc_vpc_private, stackit_network.vpc_vpc_public take the shared variable default_ipv4_nameservers, which defaults to the addresses of the STACKIT DNS Resolver (beta) in eu01 (192.214.161.53, 213.17.17.17, 188.34.111.111), so those name queries go to the resolver STACKIT operates and not to the public resolvers 1.1.1.1, 8.8.8.8 and 9.9.9.9 that STACKIT sets in a public project when none are given. The resolver is a beta product documented for workloads inside STACKIT (docs.stackit.cloud, DNS Resolver, Concepts); no check that it answers from these networks is made here, and who operates it and under which jurisdiction is not assessed here. The capability catalogue lists the STACKIT services of the draft as available in: eu01, eu02. That a service is available in a region is a fact about the service. Region assumed for pricing: eu01 (default; no input chose a region). The catalogue lists the service of 13 units there, but no input or profile has chosen the region, so no resource is tied to it.

delta.text: No source location is established, so no change of location is stated.

unknowns: The provider's own statement on data location is a statement of the provider with control shared: STACKIT states that the development of its cloud takes place in Germany, that its servers and data centers are located in Germany and Austria, and that its cloud operates in accordance with European data protection standards. It names no region id, so it does not tie any resource of the draft to a region.
Where backups, logs and replicas are stored is the subject of the backup chain and the telemetry chain.

observed_source_state.text: The jurisdiction chain (the legal seat of the provider, of its owners and of its operators, and the legal reach over them) is not assessed. It is not a fact of the Terraform source or of the draft, and legal conclusions stay external.

proposed_target_state.text: No target state is stated: the source state is not established.

unknowns: Which legal order applies to the provider, to its parent organisations and to its operators is a question for counsel, not for this build.

dimensions.name: Key control

observed_source_state.text: A customer-managed key may be stated, but its value is not visible statically, on: module.retail_app_ecs.aws_secretsmanager_secret.catalog_db, module.retail_app_ecs.aws_secretsmanager_secret.catalog_opensearch.

proposed_target_state.text: A customer-managed key is a separate setting that exists only where the source names a key: no platform encryption stands in for it, and whether the key management of the source is equivalent to the STACKIT key service is not established. Which target services of the draft can use a key of the customer is not established here.

delta.text: Whether key ownership changes is not established: the key of the source and the key of the target are not compared.

unknowns: Who holds the key material and who can use it on the target is not established.

dimensions.name: Identity chain

observed_source_state.text: The source names identities for its workloads or states them as units: module.retail_app_ecs.module.carts_service.aws_ecs_service.this, module.retail_app_ecs.module.catalog_service.aws_ecs_service.this, module.retail_app_ecs.module.checkout_service.aws_ecs_service.this, module.retail_app_ecs.module.orders_service.aws_ecs_service.this, module.retail_app_ecs.module.ui_service.aws_ecs_service.this.

proposed_target_state.text: The draft attaches a STACKIT service account to a server only where the identity plan attaches it exactly; every other attachment is stated as open. Where the draft writes a project role assignment (for an AWS role, machine user or IAM group it turns into service accounts or members), the role it grants is a variable the architect chooses, because an AWS action is not translated into a STACKIT role: the draft derives no role from the source.

delta.text: Whether the identity dependency changes is not established: the privilege delta and the external identity provider are not assessed.

unknowns: Whether an external identity provider is a dependency of the sign-in of people is not assessed.
The privilege delta between the source identities and the target roles is not assessed.

dimensions.name: Telemetry chain

observed_source_state.text: No log sink of the source is read in this run. That is not a finding that no telemetry leaves the estate.

proposed_target_state.text: The draft writes log sources as STACKIT Logs instances. Where an export of the source goes is stated in the plan of the log source, not here.

delta.text: Whether the destination of the telemetry changes is not established.

unknowns: Where metrics, traces and agent telemetry go is not read by this build.

dimensions.name: Backup chain

observed_source_state.text: The contracts of the source observe a backup, retention or geo-replication setting on: module.dependencies.module.catalog_rds.aws_rds_cluster.this, module.dependencies.module.orders_rds.aws_rds_cluster.this.

proposed_target_state.text: Where the backups of the target are stored and who operates the destination is not stated by the draft or by this build.

delta.text: Whether the destination of the backups changes is not established.

unknowns: The destination of the backups and replicas, and the jurisdiction of that destination, are not assessed.

limits: Legal conclusions remain external. The block provides technical evidence and gaps and does not certify legal compliance.
Sovereignty is not residency: a region of a service is a fact about the service, never a statement about the sovereignty of a workload.
There is no score, no percentage and no count in this block, and no dimension is compared with a requirement in this build.
Jurisdiction, operator access, open interfaces, data portability and application coupling are not assessed, and every field of the exitability model but the Terraform coupling is not assessed.

Dependencies are the units the knowledge base maps to a STACKIT service, the source providers the knowledge base holds no schema of and the source types it does not know. A dependency the draft introduces without a source unit is not listed, and a unit with no STACKIT resource is not listed as removed.
